sources.title: LDROBOT manufacturer product brochure — preserved product pages
sources.quote:
可定制自主定位导航清洁机器人主控单元
CUSTOM MCU_LD01
1. We use platform which has rich interface resources to support access to various sensors (Lidar, Cliff, Hall, TOF, IR, Collision, Ultrasonic, Gyroscope, 
Accelerometer, Magnetometer, RGB camera, 3D depth camera and other sensors) and various mechanical switches.
2. It can drive and control motors with different specifications (driving wheel, fan, side sweep, middle brush, water pump, etc.) to meet the requirements of 
various personalized functions of the autonomous positioning and navigation cleaning robot.
